Mega Infrastructure Authority 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Uttar Pradesh · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/50/2016/083 
 Dated: 31/03/2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Check Dam - Uttar Pradesh Pkg-83" (irrigation), awarded to M/s
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in
 all respects on 12/06/2016 at a gross executed value of INR 31.40 Cr (Rupees 31.40 Crore Only).
 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the workmanship
 conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Uma Sen. This certificate is issued for record and for
 submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Mega Infrastructure Authority
